scope: Terminal S2S only, matched same initial seed and previous scan. Not accuracy or deployable moving-object removal. No feedback into future history/map. All selected frames retain identical rules.
seeds: offline GT relative oracle, explicitly diagnostic only
arms: exclude each individual source facade cluster present in extracted source facade features, including neutral/positive/no accepted support
exclude all source facades, diagnostic class-ablation control
exclude source facades in one fixed right-side region x[-12,15], y[-5,-2], z[-1.6,0.5]m
selection: Retrospective actual01 known-failure development. Region chosen by visual inspection of full points and associations in committed204 record; same box used for all selected endpoints, no parameter sweep or held-out claim. Box is a diagnostic region, not an estimator proposal; it can contain static points too. Cluster IDs are local segmentation labels, not persistent objects.
producer: Verbatim passive diagnostic native source plus a single early-return gate in the S2S facade query. Disabled control must reproduce every archived natural S2S output and first-system class counts/H/g+prior. Fresh public native pair process, mapping off only for isolated S2S; forced diagnostic overrides seed. Ground/edge/intensity construction unchanged. Every modified output is terminal. No production API/default/source change.
analysis: Retain every seed/cluster output, counts and first class equations. Measure matched output/GT length and relative vector error, report every better/worse/equal result without selecting a winner. A cluster first-gradient is conditional; only iterative removals test conditional sensitivity. Removing a region does not prove physical motion; independently inspect GT-transformed full-cloud geometric shifts and static controls before attributing to moving surfaces.
